description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9): the toll-riders' captain demands tribute at the toll bar west of their fort (the quest starts within 120 m of it). Pay 1 iron, cow him (stage 4) - the fort's garrison then lets the giant pass for good - or breach the fort's gate (its strongbox: 2 iron; it also counts for Brannock's help path). 150 XP whichever way.

stages.objective: Settle the toll-riders' toll: pay it, cow their captain, or breach their gate
